services.name: Backyard Movie Rental
services.desc: Enjoy a private movie screening for up to 20 guests. Your three hour rental includes gallery admission, movie equipment set up before your arrival, one table, and access to two heaters during colder weather. Chairs are not included. Guests must bring everything they need for the screening, including chairs, blankets, food, drinks, and any additional tables. Alcohol is permitted. During our movie night season, reservations during a scheduled movie night require a full screening buyout for $700. The buyout is still limited to the same three hour private rental period.
